purpose: EXPOSED_METROLOGY_REFERENCE_ONLY: inspect actual endpoint/unit/proof-strain labels, pairing identifiers, uncertainty definitions/coverage factors and shared-error provenance in the one selected-results workbook. No ranker, fit or scientific benchmark.
authorization: Root explicitly authorizes one pinned acquisition and whole-workbook machine/researcher measurement exposure after independent scope/source review. This workbook and its derivatives are permanently exposed and excluded from any new blind predictive benchmark.
license: Record declares CC BY4.0. No blanket license transfer to linked/cited sources; embedded workbook notices must be reported if encountered.

transport.durable_request_slot: Exclusive request-slot.json is written and fsynced with its directory before opener.open. Any existing slot blocks another invocation, even when interruption prevents an acquisition receipt. Reservation alone does not establish a completed or attempted request.

exposure: Whole raw workbook, ZIP member names, admitted XML text, shared strings, visible and hidden worksheet cells, formula text/cached values and ordinary comments may be machine/researcher exposed, including actual measurements, arbitrary examples and potential contact/author information. This is permanent exposed-reference work, never fresh test evidence. Contacts and raw workbook/full-cell projection must not be published.

reader_profile.zip: In-memory only, no extraction. Source raw cap54960;1..128members; stored/deflated only; no encrypted entries, duplicate names, path traversal, symlinks or special files. Each uncompressed member<=2MiB and sum<=8MiB; compressed sizes/offsets bounded by source. zipfile validates opened local structure and CRC; no universal ZIP conformance claim.
reader_profile.active_content: Reject macro-enabled workbook content types, VBA/macrosheet/ActiveX/embedding names or types. Never execute formulas, macros, code, spreadsheet applications or links. External relationship targets are metadata only, never requested.
reader_profile.xml: Only admitted workbook/relationship/style/shared-string/worksheet/comment parts. Strict UTF8(with optional BOM); declared other encodings block. Reject decoded NUL (including NUL-separated UTF16/32 masquerading as UTF8), DOCTYPE and ENTITY before parsing. Incremental XML parsing bounds100000nodes/part and depth64; no external entity resolution. Part reads are capped at2MiB+1; total<=8MiB. Reject malformed/unsupported layout rather than guessing.
reader_profile.xlsx: Transitional OOXML namespaces; root xl/workbook.xml and declared ordinary XLSX/worksheet content types. At most32distinct worksheets,25000cells,50000shared strings,4096styles,65536characters per text/formula. No normalization, category fill-down or merged-cell duplication. Blank/hidden states, merges and original references are preserved. This is not a full OOXML schema validator. Admitted direct/rich text rejects duplicate text components, mixed direct/run text and nested text; non-inline cells reject inline-string components, and v/f scalars reject nested elements.
reader_profile.cell_values: Retain literal type, coordinate, raw v, shared/inline-string text, style index and custom format codes. Preserve formula text/attributes separately; any stored v beside formula is an unverified cached result. Never evaluate formulas, render formats, convert dates/numbers, select units or infer measurements from styles. Builtin format IDs have no inferred display code.
reader_profile.comments: Ordinary comments may be read via worksheet relationships; author names are not projected. Full comment XML machine exposure remains declared. Threaded-comment/other unsupported components are not interpreted.
reader_profile.unread_parts: Theme, images, printer settings, arbitrary custom metadata and unsupported parts are not opened. Their existence does not prove irrelevant semantics; absence of claims about them must be preserved.

outputs.public: Closed acquisition/parse status, hashes, stage exposure counts and workbook structure counts; subsequent own paraphrase with necessary factual labels/measurements and exact sheet/cell citations. These counts are document/cell counts, not independent sample counts.
ignored_only: any raw contact roster or full text export
outputs.partial_failures: Retain first request/identity/ZIP/XML/profile failure and truthful started/completed counters. No retry, alternate object, parser fallback or profile widening follows automatically.

independent_review: Child must inspect held scope/source and meaningful malformed synthetic fixtures before acquisition. One actual acquisition/reader invocation afterward; independent audit reads retained result/projection without anotherGET. Record all actual reviewer access truthfully.
